parsed.explanation: The dossier documents a nationally enacted restroom restriction by birth sex (May 2025), reaching every trans visitor who needs public facilities, with no documented working remedy. That is a tier-1 universal exposure. Compounding it, the 2017 repeal left no gender-identity hate-crime or anti-discrimination coverage in force, hate crimes are reported as rising with trans women most affected (no denominator, so magnitude is unassessed), and a legislator's dehumanising framing and public-institution contribution to discrimination are documented. Mitigators: no trans-specific criminal offence, a 2025 discrimination-motivated torture conviction (a single, dated-origin case), a court striking an anti-equality decree, and removal of pathologising health terminology. Passports and border treatment are undocumented, as are detention rules. Net: elevated risk, comparable to the 0.35 anchor tier, with the enacted facility rule and lack of recourse dominating.
